summary: Son of Richard Heffernan and Anastasia Boney who married Ellen Kelly; John's 1st cousin 5 times removed.
bio: James Heffernan was born in 1838, a son of Richard Heffernan and Anastasia Boney. In 1860 he was living with his mother at Plymouth. He married Ellen Kelly and died in 1910.
sources: Michael Dwyer, Heffernans of Slieveardagh (Welsh Hill Press, 2020), Branch 4 (and Branch 3), working from the Killenaule and Gortnahoe Catholic parish registers: https://archive.org/details/heffernans-of-slieveardagh
